notes.title: If you had problems running our DEMO of Trials of Harmony... It's now fixed!
notes.content:
If you've encountered problems running our DEMO of Trials of Harmony, and you got stuck right after the end of its intro, then you've run into a pretty nasty bug [u]exclusive to the DEMO version[/u] of Trials of Harmony. 

[b]This problem has now been identified and a patch has been released to fix this issue.[/b]

I apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused you, and have fun playing the DEMO.


Stay Awesome,
Nuno Faria @ SilverTabbyCat
